evidence: In the south the track begins at the end of Waikakaho Road.
Then through several gates for 2 km to a parking area beside the Waikakaho River.
It eventually descends and crosses Cullen Creek to the road end and the site of the former mining town, Cullensville.
Access to the start of the track at the northern end is at Cullen Creek Valley from Linkwater.

doubts: The southern start is 'the end of Waikakaho Road'; two road-end features lie on Waikakaho Road (F2, an unnamed track; F3, where the Cullen Creek Walkway meets it). F3 was chosen because the named walkway meets the road there, but it could be F2 if the road end is reckoned before the 2 km through farm gates to the parking area. The way is recorded south to north as the Description presents it; the page also calls the northern end (Cullen Creek Valley) a start, so the walk can be done in reverse. The hut passed is private, not a DOC hut.
